Decide the purpose of the thread
This means deciding what set of instructions the thread is carrying out, this is to be a very specific goal where it can be run independently
Create a function for the thread
This function entails the purpose of the thread. This is the function that will carry out the task. The function is called and use during the runtime/usage of the thread.
Initialize the Kernel
The kernel needs to be initialized if it has not been set up prior
Set up the thread
Create a thread object and assign the function that the thread will use. Can also initialize input arguments depending on the purpose of the function
Start the thread
Call a method to start the thread! This will tell the system to start running the thread while running other programs in the background
Start the kernel
This begins thread execution and then hands over control to the operating system, so the thread continues to run
Let the thread run
The thread will run in the background independently
